All requirements and invariants for **BENCH-009: Multi-File Token-Bucket Rate Limiter** have been resolved across [models.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-009_35032_1795292628547_baseline/models.py), [bucket.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-009_35032_1795292628547_baseline/bucket.py), [registry.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-009_35032_1795292628547_baseline/registry.py), and [middleware.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-009_35032_1795292628547_baseline/middleware.py):

### Summary of Changes
- **`models.py`**:
  - `as_decimal(value)`: Strictly validates input (rejects booleans, non-finite, negative, or unsupported types with `ValueError`) and converts `Decimal`, `int`, `str`, or `float` using `Decimal(str(value))`.
  - `BucketState`: Normalizes all fields (`capacity`, `refill_rate`, `tokens`, `updated_at`) to `Decimal`. Ensures `capacity > 0`, `tokens <= capacity`, and `updated_at >= 0`. Allows `refill_rate == 0`.
- **`bucket.py`**:
  - `TokenBucket.__init__`: Starts full (`tokens = capacity`), timestamped using the injected `clock()`.
  - `refill(now=None)`: Uses injected `clock()` when `now=None`. Exactly computes `elapsed * refill_rate` and caps at `capacity` using exact `Decimal` arithmetic without float conversions. Ignores backward time (`now <= state.updated_at`).
  - `consume(amount=1, now=None)`: Rejects non-positive amounts with `ValueError` prior to any mutation. Refills and deducts tokens if available; returns `False` without deducting if insufficient.
- **`registry.py`**:
  - Indexes buckets cleanly by `(tenant_id, bucket_name)` without shared mutable default arguments.
  - `add`: Raises `ValueError` without replacement on duplicate `(tenant_id, name)`.
  - `get`: Raises `KeyError` if key is missing.
- **`middleware.py`**:
  - `RateLimiter.consume`: Evaluates requests (supporting arbitrary iterables/generators and empty requests). Validates all amounts are positive (`ValueError`) and resolves all buckets (`KeyError`) before performing state mutations.
  - Samples `registry.clock()` once per non-empty request and synchronizes refills across all participating buckets. Aggregates repeated bucket names.
  - Atomic all-or-nothing rollback: restores all participating bucket `tokens` and `updated_at` to pre-request states on `False` or exception. Deducts aggregated amounts only on success.
